Two women, an African American construction worker and an African American scientist, were in the line to check out in the grocery store. The African American construction worker used a SNAP card to pay for her groceries, while the other woman pulled out black Amex card. Which person receives government benefits?
A. The African American construction worker
B. The African American scientist
C. Cannot be determined
